definitions.explanation: In IT and systems engineering, the degree to which a system or service is operational and accessible when needed. One of the key metrics for measuring system reliability.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可用性|かようせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧。
examples.english: We improve the availability of the system.

examples.japanese: {可用性|かようせい}99.9%⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{冗長|じょうちょう}→冗長：07655_jouchou⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{可用性|かようせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We achieved high availability through redundant configuration.

notes:
{可用性|かようせい} is a technical IT term referring to system uptime and accessibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高|たか}{可用性|かようせい}: high availability (HA)
- {可用性|かようせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ensure availability
- {可用性|かようせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる: to improve availability

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{信頼性|しんらいせい}→信頼性：05572_shinraisei⟧: reliability
- {耐障害性|たいしょうがいせい}: fault tolerance
- ⟦{冗長性|じょうちょうせい}→冗長性：24002_jouchousei⟧: redundancy

TECHNICAL NOTE:
Availability is often expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.9% = "three nines"). The term is part of the IT triad of {機密性|きみつせい} (confidentiality), {完全性|かんぜんせい} (integrity), and {可用性|かようせい} (availability), known as CIA.
